title: Upward Technologies launches free 7-day trial of Assure, its ISO-compliance software
content_html: On 16 October 2026, Upward Technologies opened the beta of Assure. Anyone can try Assure free for 7 days. Assure is software for document control and compliance evidence. It keeps controlled documents with their workflow, approvals and audit trail, whether the files are stored inside Assure, in Google Drive or with another approved storage provider. The same controlled record can serve several companies and projects. Assure supports the controls required by ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 42001, SOC 2, NEN 7510, NIS2, DORA, the AI Act and GDPR, and helps implement and evidence them. Software alone does not make an organisation compliant; it provides the record needed to show compliance.
